activity_summary: At breakfast you paid threepence for the meal and twopence for a horn of ink. Mistress Ansell filled it because yesterday's spoon had been in the galls. The Sunday letter stayed folded for Thursday. You had no newer word of your father than that he was mending. You did not open the sheet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid for the horn and the meal, and kept Thursday as the day the letter goes.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Filled the horn at twopence and refused to let the letter be opened into a promise.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Kept the soaking spoon out of the new horn, and asked after the cough only once.

facets.activity: Bought a horn of ink and kept the letter folded

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Fill it. Twopence, as you sell it.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have no newer word than mending.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Your letter is where you left it.
